messages.subject: typo? Shiny manual
parts:
Hi,

On page 11 of the manual which describes the language codes in control dateInput, the code for the Portuguese language appears twice.

The language used for month and day names. Default is "en". Other valid values
include "bg", "ca", "cs", "da", "de", "el", "es", "fi", "fr", "he", "hr", "hu", "id",
"is", "it", "ja", "kr", "lt", "lv", "ms", "nb", "nl", "pl", "pt", "pt", "ro", "rs", "rslatin",
"ru", "sk", "sl", "sv", "sw", "th", "tr", "uk", "zh-CN", and "zh-TW".
 
Perhaps the correct one is "pt" and "pt-br" which differentiates Portuguese of Portugal and Brazil, isn´t ?

Joao

messages.subject: Re: typo? Shiny manual
parts:
Thanks, I've fixed it so that it refers to"pt" and "pt-BR".

-Winston
